name: so.figment/mac
title: Figment Mac hosting
description: Rent a Mac by the hour or day. An MCP server and a skill let AI agents order, use and stop it.

tools.name: figment_get_offer
tools.description: Plans, prices in US cents, limits, billing rules and whether a Mac of each plan is free now. No key needed.

tools.name: figment_create_account
tools.description: Makes an agent account with no credit and returns its api_key once. No sign-in. Call it one time and keep the key; do not make a new account for each task.

contact_email.description: Optional email of your user, for support only.

tools.name: figment_get_account
tools.description: Credit balance in cents, the Macs of this account with their states, the limits, and a claim link that lets your user see the account in a browser.

api_key.description: The api_key from figment_create_account. Leave out if the MCP connection sends an Authorization header.

tools.name: figment_buy_credit
tools.description: Returns a Stripe Checkout link for prepaid credit. Give the link to your user to pay, or pay it with a Link wallet. The first purchase is at least 2500 cents; one purchase is at most 50000 cents. This call takes no money by itself.

idempotency_key.description: A new random string of 16 to 80 letters, digits, "_" or "-" for each new purchase or order. Send the same string again only to repeat the same request.

api_key.description: The api_key from figment_create_account. Leave out if the MCP connection sends an Authorization header.

tools.name: figment_start_mac
tools.description: Orders an hourly or daily Mac and pays for it from account credit. Billing starts when the order is accepted. Only call it when your user allowed you to rent a Mac. Answers credit_required when the account needs more credit.

accept_terms.description: true after your user accepts the terms at figment.so/terms.

authorization.description: Your user allowed you to rent a Mac for them.

intel_compatibility_accepted.description: Required for intel-vm. See the notice in the offer.

allow_wait.description: Order although no Mac of this plan is free now.

ssh_public_key.description: Optional. Stored for a later install; not installed in this version.

idempotency_key.description: A new random string of 16 to 80 letters, digits, "_" or "-" for each new purchase or order. Send the same string again only to repeat the same request.

api_key.description: The api_key from figment_create_account. Leave out if the MCP connection sends an Authorization header.

tools.name: figment_get_mac
tools.description: State of one Mac: provisioning, ready, stopping, stopped, ended_before_setup, deleted or failed, with cost so far. Poll no more than once every 30 seconds.

api_key.description: The api_key from figment_create_account. Leave out if the MCP connection sends an Authorization header.

tools.name: figment_get_mac_access
tools.description: SSH host and port for a ready Mac. With console true, also a one-time link to the Mac screen in a browser. With login true, also the Mac account name and password when available. The password is a secret: do not show it in chat or write it to logs.

api_key.description: The api_key from figment_create_account. Leave out if the MCP connection sends an Authorization header.

tools.name: figment_stop_mac
tools.description: Ends the rental. Access stops and billing stops. The Mac cannot be started again; its data is kept seven days, then deleted. Do this when the task is done.

api_key.description: The api_key from figment_create_account. Leave out if the MCP connection sends an Authorization header.
